answer: Require each identity to stake a copper bond that is only refunded after it solves a fresh cipher puzzle bound to one physical relic, such as a device attestation key that cannot be cloned or shared. The puzzle takes real time on that device, and the bond is slashed if the same relic vouches for two identities or submits conflicting work. A single attacker can therefore only run as many identities as it owns devices, each costing purchase, power, and locked capital, while honest agents pay once and reuse their standing across epochs.
